user_query: Show the 3-step mock exam completion funnel from app launch to submission
reference_sql: SELECT '1. App Launch' AS funnel_step, 1 AS step_order, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'app_launch' THEN learner_id END) AS unique_learners FROM telemetry_events UNION ALL SELECT '2. Exam Started', 2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) FROM telemetry_events UNION ALL SELECT '3. Exam Submitted', 3, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN learner_id END) FROM telemetry_events ORDER BY step_order ASC LIMIT 1000

user_query: What is the mock exam funnel completion drop-off over the last 7 days?
reference_sql: SELECT '1. App Launch' AS funnel_step, 1 AS step_order, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'app_launch' THEN learner_id END) AS unique_learners FROM telemetry_events WHERE occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') UNION ALL SELECT '2. Exam Started', 2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) FROM telemetry_events WHERE occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') UNION ALL SELECT '3. Exam Submitted', 3, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN learner_id END) FROM telemetry_events WHERE occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') ORDER BY step_order ASC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Compare mock exam starts vs mock exam submissions in the last 14 days
reference_sql: SELECT event_name, COUNT(DISTINCT learner_id) AS distinct_learners FROM telemetry_events WHERE event_name IN ('mock_exam_started', 'mock_exam_submitted') AND occurred_at >= date('now', '-14 days') GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY distinct_learners DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: How many learners viewed the paywall after starting a mock exam?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.learner_id) AS paywall_viewers FROM telemetry_events t1 JOIN telemetry_events t2 ON t1.learner_id = t2.learner_id WHERE t1.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' AND t2.event_name = 'paywall_viewed' AND t2.occurred_at >= t1.occurred_at LIMIT 1000

user_query: Show conversion rate from syllabus explored to mock exam started
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'syllabus_explored' THEN learner_id END) AS syllabus_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) AS exam_learners, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'syllabus_explored' THEN learner_id END), 0), 2) AS syllabus_to_exam_conversion_pct FROM telemetry_events LIMIT 1000

user_query: What is the mock exam submission rate for Android users in the last 7 days?
reference_sql: SELECT l.device_os, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN t.learner_id END) AS starts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN t.learner_id END) AS submits, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN t.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN t.learner_id END), 0), 2) AS submission_rate_pct FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE l.device_os = 'Android' AND t.occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY l.device_os LIMIT 1000
initial_defect_description: Initial draft used Postgres interval syntax which failed in SQLite; healed on attempt 1

user_query: What is the mock exam submission rate for iOS users in the last 7 days?
reference_sql: SELECT l.device_os, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN t.learner_id END) AS starts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN t.learner_id END) AS submits, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN t.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN t.learner_id END), 0), 2) AS submission_rate_pct FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE l.device_os = 'iOS' AND t.occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY l.device_os LIMIT 1000

user_query: Exam completion funnel breakdown by app version
reference_sql: SELECT app_version, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) AS starts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN learner_id END) AS submits, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END), 0), 2) AS completion_pct FROM telemetry_events GROUP BY app_version ORDER BY app_version DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Funnel conversion from app launch to syllabus exploration by acquisition channel
reference_sql: SELECT l.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'app_launch' THEN t.learner_id END) AS launched_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'syllabus_explored' THEN t.learner_id END) AS syllabus_learners, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'syllabus_explored' THEN t.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'app_launch' THEN t.learner_id END), 0), 2) AS launch_to_syllabus_pct FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id GROUP BY l.acquisition_channel ORDER BY launch_to_syllabus_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Funnel conversion from app launch to mock exam started by city tier
reference_sql: SELECT l.city_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'app_launch' THEN t.learner_id END) AS launches, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN t.learner_id END) AS exam_starts, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN t.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'app_launch' THEN t.learner_id END), 0), 2) AS launch_to_exam_pct FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id GROUP BY l.city_tier ORDER BY launch_to_exam_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: What percentage of YouTube Creators acquisitions complete a mock exam?
reference_sql: SELECT l.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id) AS total_channel_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN t.learner_id END) AS exam_completers, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN t.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id), 0), 2) AS completion_rate_pct FROM learners l LEFT JOIN telemetry_events t ON l.learner_id = t.learner_id WHERE l.acquisition_channel = 'YouTube Creators' GROUP BY l.acquisition_channel LIMIT 1000
initial_defect_description: Initial draft referenced non-existent column 'channel'; self-healed to 'acquisition_channel'

user_query: What percentage of Meta Ads acquisitions reach the paywall?
reference_sql: SELECT l.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id) AS total_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'paywall_viewed' THEN t.learner_id END) AS paywall_viewers, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.event_name = 'paywall_viewed' THEN t.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id), 0), 2) AS paywall_view_rate_pct FROM learners l LEFT JOIN telemetry_events t ON l.learner_id = t.learner_id WHERE l.acquisition_channel = 'Meta Ads' GROUP BY l.acquisition_channel LIMIT 1000

user_query: Daily count of mock exam submitted events over the past 30 days
reference_sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS event_date, COUNT(event_id) AS total_exam_submits FROM telemetry_events WHERE event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' AND occurred_at >= date('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY DATE(occurred_at) ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Drop-off count between mock exam started and mock exam submitted for v2.4.1
reference_sql: SELECT app_version, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) AS started_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN learner_id END) AS submitted_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_started' THEN learner_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' THEN learner_id END)) AS dropoff_learners FROM telemetry_events WHERE app_version = 'v2.4.1' GROUP BY app_version LIMIT 1000

user_query: Funnel conversion from paywall viewed to paid subscription
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.learner_id) AS paywall_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT s.learner_id) AS paid_learners, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.learner_id), 0), 2) AS paywall_to_paid_conversion_pct FROM telemetry_events t LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.learner_id = s.learner_id AND s.payment_status = 'completed' WHERE t.event_name = 'paywall_viewed' LIMIT 1000

user_query: Calculate D7 cohort retention rate for all signup dates
reference_sql: WITH learner_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, DATE(signup_timestamp) AS cohort_date FROM learners), day_7_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.cohort_date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS retained_learners_d7, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_rate_pct FROM learner_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_7_activity a ON c.learner_id = a.learner_id GROUP BY c.cohort_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) > 0 ORDER BY c.cohort_date DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: What is D7 retention for learners registered in the last 14 days?
reference_sql: WITH learner_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, DATE(signup_timestamp) AS cohort_date FROM learners WHERE signup_timestamp >= date('now', '-14 days')), day_7_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.cohort_date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS retained_learners_d7, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_rate_pct FROM learner_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_7_activity a ON c.learner_id = a.learner_id GROUP BY c.cohort_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) > 0 ORDER BY c.cohort_date DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: D7 cohort retention rate broken down by device OS
reference_sql: WITH learner_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, device_os, DATE(signup_timestamp) AS cohort_date FROM learners), day_7_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.device_os, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS retained_learners_d7, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_rate_pct FROM learner_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_7_activity a ON c.learner_id = a.learner_id GROUP BY c.device_os ORDER BY d7_retention_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1000
initial_defect_description: Failed on SQLite date arithmetic missing '+' prefix; self-healed on iteration 1

user_query: D7 retention rate for Campus Referral learners vs Organic Search
reference_sql: WITH learner_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, acquisition_channel FROM learners WHERE acquisition_channel IN ('Campus Referral', 'Organic Search')), day_7_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS retained_learners_d7, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_pct FROM learner_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_7_activity a ON c.learner_id = a.learner_id GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel ORDER BY d7_retention_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Weekly signup cohort sizes for the last 6 weeks
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', signup_timestamp) AS signup_week, COUNT(learner_id) AS learners_registered FROM learners WHERE signup_timestamp >= date('now', '-42 days') GROUP BY signup_week ORDER BY signup_week DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Calculate D1 retention rate for learners registered in the last 30 days
reference_sql: WITH learner_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, DATE(signup_timestamp) AS cohort_date FROM learners WHERE signup_timestamp >= date('now', '-30 days')), day_1_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+1 days')) SELECT c.cohort_date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS retained_learners_d1, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d1_retention_rate_pct FROM learner_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_1_activity a ON c.learner_id = a.learner_id GROUP BY c.cohort_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) > 0 ORDER BY c.cohort_date DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: D7 cohort retention rate segmented by city tier
reference_sql: WITH learner_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, city_tier FROM learners), day_7_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.city_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS retained_learners_d7, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_rate_pct FROM learner_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_7_activity a ON c.learner_id = a.learner_id GROUP BY c.city_tier ORDER BY d7_retention_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Retention rate of learners who completed an AI doubt session within 24 hours of signup
reference_sql: WITH doubt_learners AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.learner_id FROM ai_doubt_sessions d JOIN learners l ON d.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE d.created_at <= datetime(l.signup_timestamp, '+1 day')), active_retention AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dl.learner_id) AS doubt_users_cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.learner_id) AS retained_d7, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ar.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dl.learner_id), 0), 2) AS doubt_cohort_d7_retention_pct FROM doubt_learners dl LEFT JOIN active_retention ar ON dl.learner_id = ar.learner_id LIMIT 1000
initial_defect_description: Self-healed ambiguous column name 'created_at' to qualified 'd.created_at'

user_query: What is the 14-day retention rate of paying subscribers vs free learners?
reference_sql: WITH learner_types AS (SELECT l.learner_id, CASE WHEN s.subscription_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Paying' ELSE 'Free' END AS learner_type, l.signup_timestamp FROM learners l LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON l.learner_id = s.learner_id AND s.payment_status = 'completed'), day_14_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+14 days')) SELECT lt.learner_type, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.learner_id) AS total_cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT d.learner_id) AS retained_d14, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT d.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT lt.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d14_retention_pct FROM learner_types lt LEFT JOIN day_14_activity d ON lt.learner_id = d.learner_id GROUP BY lt.learner_type LIMIT 1000

user_query: Average distinct active days per learner in their first 30 days post-signup
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(active_days), 2) AS avg_active_days_first_month FROM (SELECT t.learner_id, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(t.occurred_at)) AS active_days FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE t.occurred_at <= datetime(l.signup_timestamp, '+30 days') GROUP BY t.learner_id) LIMIT 1000

user_query: Cohort size and D7 retained learners for YouTube Creators cohort
reference_sql: WITH yt_cohort AS (SELECT learner_id, DATE(signup_timestamp) AS signup_date FROM learners WHERE acquisition_channel = 'YouTube Creators'), d7_active AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT y.signup_date, COUNT(DISTINCT y.learner_id) AS yt_cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT d.learner_id) AS d7_retained, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT d.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT y.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_pct FROM yt_cohort y LEFT JOIN d7_active d ON y.learner_id = d.learner_id GROUP BY y.signup_date ORDER BY y.signup_date DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Learners who signed up 7 days ago and completed an exam today
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id) AS d7_exam_completers FROM learners l JOIN telemetry_events t ON l.learner_id = t.learner_id WHERE DATE(l.signup_timestamp) = date('now', '-7 days') AND t.event_name = 'mock_exam_submitted' AND DATE(t.occurred_at) = date('now') LIMIT 1000

user_query: Retention rate comparison across all acquisition channels at Day 7
reference_sql: WITH cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, acquisition_channel, signup_timestamp FROM learners), retained AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS total_signed_up, COUNT(DISTINCT r.learner_id) AS d7_retained, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_pct FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN retained r ON c.learner_id = r.learner_id GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel ORDER BY d7_retention_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Count of learners with 0 activity events post-signup (churned day 0)
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(l.learner_id) AS zero_activity_learners FROM learners l LEFT JOIN telemetry_events t ON l.learner_id = t.learner_id WHERE t.event_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000

user_query: Retention rate of Tier 1 city learners compared to Tier 3 at Day 7
reference_sql: WITH city_cohorts AS (SELECT learner_id, city_tier FROM learners WHERE city_tier IN ('Tier 1', 'Tier 3')), day_7 AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.learner_id FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE DATE(t.occurred_at) = DATE(l.signup_timestamp, '+7 days')) SELECT c.city_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT d.learner_id) AS retained_count, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT d.learner_id) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.learner_id), 0), 2) AS d7_retention_pct FROM city_cohorts c LEFT JOIN day_7 d ON c.learner_id = d.learner_id GROUP BY c.city_tier ORDER BY d7_retention_pct DESC LIMIT 1000
initial_defect_description: Initial draft missing NULLIF protection for small cohort denominator; self-healed

user_query: What is our Daily Active Learners count for each day over the last 7 days?
reference_sql: SELECT DATE(t.occurred_at) AS metric_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.learner_id) AS daily_active_learners FROM telemetry_events t WHERE t.event_name IN ('mock_exam_started', 'syllabus_explored') AND t.occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY DATE(t.occurred_at) ORDER BY metric_date DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Daily Active Learners grouped by device OS in the past 7 days
reference_sql: SELECT DATE(t.occurred_at) AS metric_date, l.device_os, COUNT(DISTINCT t.learner_id) AS daily_active_learners FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE t.event_name IN ('mock_exam_started', 'syllabus_explored') AND t.occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY DATE(t.occurred_at), l.device_os ORDER BY metric_date DESC, daily_active_learners DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Show total recognized revenue and completed orders by acquisition channel
reference_sql: SELECT l.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT s.subscription_id) AS completed_orders, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue_inr), 2) AS total_revenue_inr, ROUND(AVG(s.revenue_inr), 2) AS avg_order_value_inr FROM subscriptions s JOIN learners l ON s.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE s.payment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY l.acquisition_channel ORDER BY total_revenue_inr DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: What is the overall paid subscription conversion rate across all learners?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id) AS total_registered_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.payment_status = 'completed' THEN s.learner_id END) AS total_paying_learners, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.payment_status = 'completed' THEN s.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id), 0), 2) AS paid_conversion_rate_pct FROM learners l LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON l.learner_id = s.learner_id LIMIT 1000

user_query: Paid subscription conversion rate broken down by acquisition channel
reference_sql: SELECT l.acquisition_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id) AS total_registered_learners, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.payment_status = 'completed' THEN s.learner_id END) AS total_paying_learners, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.payment_status = 'completed' THEN s.learner_id END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.learner_id), 0), 2) AS paid_conversion_rate_pct FROM learners l LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON l.learner_id = s.learner_id GROUP BY l.acquisition_channel ORDER BY paid_conversion_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Average session latency in milliseconds for each app version
reference_sql: SELECT app_version, COUNT(event_id) AS total_events, ROUND(AVG(session_latency_ms), 2) AS avg_latency_ms, MAX(session_latency_ms) AS max_latency_ms FROM telemetry_events GROUP BY app_version ORDER BY avg_latency_ms DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Average AI doubt solver response latency and satisfaction rating
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(session_id) AS total_doubt_sessions, ROUND(AVG(response_latency_ms), 1) AS avg_response_latency_ms, ROUND(AVG(resolution_rating), 2) AS avg_satisfaction_rating, ROUND(AVG(token_consumption), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_session FROM ai_doubt_sessions LIMIT 1000

user_query: Revenue breakdown by subscription plan tier (Monthly Pro vs Annual Pass)
reference_sql: SELECT plan_tier, COUNT(subscription_id) AS completed_subs, ROUND(SUM(revenue_inr), 2) AS total_revenue_inr, ROUND(AVG(revenue_inr), 2) AS avg_plan_revenue FROM subscriptions WHERE payment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY plan_tier ORDER BY total_revenue_inr DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Total tokens consumed by AI doubt solver segmented by city tier
reference_sql: SELECT l.city_tier, COUNT(d.session_id) AS doubt_sessions, SUM(d.token_consumption) AS total_tokens_consumed, ROUND(AVG(d.token_consumption), 1) AS avg_tokens_per_session FROM ai_doubt_sessions d JOIN learners l ON d.learner_id = l.learner_id GROUP BY l.city_tier ORDER BY total_tokens_consumed DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Failed vs refunded vs completed subscription count and revenue loss
reference_sql: SELECT payment_status, COUNT(subscription_id) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'completed' THEN revenue_inr ELSE 1499.00 END), 2) AS nominal_value_inr FROM subscriptions GROUP BY payment_status ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Telemetry events with session latency exceeding 4500ms in the last 7 days
reference_sql: SELECT event_name, app_version, COUNT(event_id) AS slow_events_count, ROUND(AVG(session_latency_ms), 1) AS avg_slow_latency_ms FROM telemetry_events WHERE session_latency_ms > 4500 AND occurred_at >= date('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY event_name, app_version ORDER BY slow_events_count DESC LIMIT 1000
initial_defect_description: Initial draft missed DATE() conversion on datetime string; self-healed on retry

user_query: Distribution of learners across city tiers and device OS
reference_sql: SELECT city_tier, device_os, COUNT(learner_id) AS total_learners FROM learners GROUP BY city_tier, device_os ORDER BY city_tier ASC, total_learners DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Most popular hour of day for app launches
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%H', occurred_at) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(event_id) AS total_launches FROM telemetry_events WHERE event_name = 'app_launch' GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY total_launches DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Average satisfaction rating for AI doubt sessions having latency under 1000ms vs over 2000ms
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN response_latency_ms < 1000 THEN 'Fast (<1s)' WHEN response_latency_ms > 2000 THEN 'Slow (>2s)' ELSE 'Moderate (1-2s)' END AS latency_bucket, COUNT(session_id) AS sessions_count, ROUND(AVG(resolution_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM ai_doubt_sessions GROUP BY latency_bucket ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 1000

user_query: Learners count who experienced app latency > 4000ms on Android v2.4.1
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.learner_id) AS affected_learners FROM telemetry_events t JOIN learners l ON t.learner_id = l.learner_id WHERE l.device_os = 'Android' AND t.app_version = 'v2.4.1' AND t.session_latency_ms > 4000 LIMIT 1000

user_query: Total revenue generated by Monthly Pro subscribers in the last 30 days
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue_inr), 2) AS monthly_pro_revenue FROM subscriptions WHERE plan_tier = 'Monthly Pro' AND payment_status = 'completed' AND activated_at >= date('now', '-30 days') LIMIT 1000
